Shoplinker manual order registration

API for registering orders in Shoplinker

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Order/order_insert.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required shoplinker_id string Shoplinker account
3. Required mall_order_id string Marketplace order number
4. Required mall_id string Marketplace code Optional
  1. - APISHOP_0000 (Shoplinker marketplace code)
  2. - 14145 (sales customer code)
 Marketplace code
Sales customer code You can query this in Additional Administrator Functions [Basic Information Query].
5. Required order_name string Buyer name
6. Required order_tel string Buyer phone number
7. Required order_cel string Buyer mobile number
8. order_email string Buyer email address
9. Required receive string Recipient name
10. Required receive_tel string Recipient phone number
11. Required receive_cel string Recipient mobile number
12. Required receive_zipcode string Recipient postal code
13. Required receive_addr string Recipient address
14. Required baesong_type string Shipping fee payment method Optional
  1. - 001 : Free shipping
  2. - 002 : Freight collect
  3. - 003 : Prepaid
15. baesong_bi string Shipping fee
16. delivery_msg string Delivery message Store pickup or overseas orders are shown in msg. ex: Customer request...[Store pickup] or overseas delivery order
17. Required mall_product_id string Marketplace product code
18. partner_product_id string Your own product code
19. Required product_name string Product name
20. Required quantity string Total order quantity
21. Required order_price string Total order amount
22. sale_price string Unit sale price
23. Required supply_price string Supply price
24. Required sku string Option name
25. Required seller_id string Marketplace account

APIThe script tag that loads it can be placed in the HTML file's head, body or elsewhere in the file. However, it must be declared before the execution code. 

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<header>
		<customer_id>a0000018</customer_id>
		<shoplinker_id>shop123</shoplinker_id>
	</header>
	<order_list>
		<mall_order_id><![CDATA[20100415059601-001-001-001]]></mall_order_id>
		<order_name><![CDATA[안은실]]></order_name>
		<order_tel><![CDATA[010-3139-7940]]></order_tel>
		<order_cel><![CDATA[010-123-4567]]></order_cel>
		<order_email><![CDATA[SHOP@NAVER.COM]]></order_email>
		<receive><![CDATA[안은실]]></receive>
		<receive_tel><![CDATA[010-3139-7940]]></receive_tel>
		<receive_cel><![CDATA[010-3139-7940]]></receive_cel>
		<receive_zipcode><![CDATA[407-727]]></receive_zipcode>
		<receive_addr><![CDATA[인천 계양구 동양동 586번지]]></receive_addr>
		<baesong_type><![CDATA[착불]]></baesong_type>
		<baesong_bi>2500</baesong_bi>
		<delivery_msg><![CDATA[빠른 배송 부탁드립니다.]]></delivery_msg>
		<partner_product_id>><![CDATA[54625]]></partner_product_id>
		<product_name><![CDATA[Kitchen 애플파이]]></product_name>
		<quantity>2</quantity>
		<order_price>3000</order_price>
		<sale_price>1500</sale_price>
		<supply_price>1350</supply_price>
		<sku><![CDATA[yellow-2개]]></sku>
		<seller_id><![CDATA[shoplinker]]></seller_id>
	</order_list>
	.
	.
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Optional
  • - Success : true
  • - Failure : false
2. id string Marketplace order number
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="EUC-KR"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<id>12345</id>
		<message>등록성공 완료</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
